applies_why: The judge text does the thing the rule governs by basing an UNDERDETERMINED label partly on the almah/bethulah word-count cutting both ways.
quote: the almah/bethulah word-count cuts both ways (Joel 1:8)
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand — one reading treats two-sense evidence as UNDERDETERMINED; the other treats it as not open, with both senses standing.
why: Because the judge used the almah/bethulah word-count cutting both ways as part of why C5 is UNDERDETERMINED, contrary to K-S2's command that a two-sense verse is not open and both senses stand.
